head: GHOSTED
BY A
<g>JOB?</g>
SEND THIS.
hacks: Wait two weeks before you chase.
Too soon looks impatient, but two weeks is plenty of time.
Count fourteen days from the day you applied.
A warm tone works better than a blunt demand.
Start with I hope you are having a good week.
Ask a simple yes or no question.
Busy recruiters ignore long emails with multiple points.
Ask if they are still reviewing applications.
State your interest in one sentence.
Remind them why you applied without repeating your CV.
Mention one specific reason the role suits you.
Send it mid morning on a tuesday.
Monday is full of catch up and friday is too quiet.
Schedule your message for ten in the morning.
out: Send it to a mate waiting on news
